intent: A labelled section of a Combobox's list, grouping related items under one ComboboxLabel.
typical_uses: One section of a grouped list, such as the regions of one continent

dont_use_when.situation: A plain divider between items with no section label

invariants.text: The group renders with role "group" and takes its accessible name from the ComboboxLabel inside it, through `aria-labelledby`, unless the caller passes its own `aria-labelledby`; a group with neither has no name.
combobox.module.css gives the group no padding and no divider, only a scroll margin; the list pads every item the same whether or not a group encloses it.
`items` is the list a ComboboxCollection inside this group maps over; a group whose items are written out by hand needs none.

render.states: render replaces the rendered element with one the caller supplies
render.because: Base UI's render prop takes an element or a function of the group's own state, so its type is a union of a React element and a callback - the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

style.states: style accepts a function of the group's state as well as a plain style object
style.because: Base UI widens React's `CSSProperties` to `CSSProperties | ((state) => CSSProperties)` so a caller can style off the primitive's own state (empty for this part). The compiler emits one JSON type per property, so nothing is asserted; the kit's own styling goes through combobox.module.css, not through this.

good.title: A group rendered from one entry of grouped items

bad.title: A made-up heading prop
bad.why: The group takes no `heading`; its title is a ComboboxLabel placed inside it, which is also what names the group.
